result.task: Check the storage options and prices for the latest iPad Pro models on Apple's website.
result.final_answer:
## iPad Pro Storage Options and Prices (Latest Model)

Based on the current Apple website (apple.com/shop/buy-ipad/ipad-pro), the latest iPad Pro is powered by the **M5 chip** and is offered in two sizes — **11-inch** and **13-inch** — each with four storage tiers. Both models come in Space Black or Silver finishes.

### 🖥️ 11-inch iPad Pro (M5) — *starting from $1,199*

| Storage | Memory | Chip Configuration | Price |
|---------|--------|--------------------|-------|
| 256GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,199** |
| 512GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,399** |
| 1TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,799** |
| 2TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,299** |

### 🖥️ 13-inch iPad Pro (M5) — *starting from $1,499*

| Storage | Memory | Chip Configuration | Price |
|---------|--------|--------------------|-------|
| 256GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,499** |
| 512GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,699** |
| 1TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,099** |
| 2TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,599** |

### Notes
- **Step-up pricing within a model:** $200 between storage tiers up to 1TB, then $400 between 1TB and 2TB (e.g., 256→512GB +$200, 512GB→1TB +$400, 1TB→2TB +$500).
- **Step-up pricing between models:** The 13-inch costs exactly **$300 more** than the 11-inch at any given storage tier.
- All prices can also be financed at approximately $99.91–$216.58/mo for 12 months, or leased for 36 months from $24.99–$53.74/mo.
- Storage tiers of 256GB and 512GB ship with **12GB RAM** and the standard 9-core CPU M5, while 1TB and 2TB tiers upgrade to **16GB RAM** and the full 10-core CPU M5.

Source: apple.com/shop/buy-ipad/ipad-pro (captured September 17, 2026).
